repos.name: paul.emini.com
repos.description: My personal site and résumé, with an AI agent that answers questions about my career and replies with interactive cards instead of walls of text.
repos.readme: My personal site and résumé, with an AI agent that answers questions about my career and replies with interactive cards instead of walls of text.

repos.name: smartthings-agui
repos.description: Talk to your SmartThings home from any AG-UI agent: CopilotKit frontend tools, A2UI device cards, and a confirmation step before anything security-sensitive.
repos.readme: Talk to your SmartThings home from any AG-UI agent, with device cards in the chat, a confirmation step before anything security-sensitive moves, and a SmartThings token that never leaves your browser.

repos.name: tomodachi-llm
repos.description: A fan mod for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream that integrates a LLM into the game, providing bespoke dialogues and captions for your gameplay.
repos.readme: A fan mod for Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) into the game, supplying it with context about your characters and their environment, and in turn providing bespoke dialogues and captions for your gameplay. Never hear the same thing twice. Always tailored to your game.

repos.name: ragout
repos.description: An expert car-mechanic assistant powered by a multimodal RAG agent grounded in your specific vehicle's service manuals and technical service bulletins (TSBs)
repos.readme: Got a stack of service manuals catching dust and no time to dig through them for one answer? Let Ragoût cook something up for you — an expert car-mechanic assistant powered by a multimodal RAG agent grounded in your specific vehicle's service manuals and technical service bulletins (TSBs).

repos.name: ralph-node
repos.description: An orchestrated, test-gated AI development pipeline for Node.js using a Ralph loop — turn a simple paragraph into a planned, tested, reviewed, fully working implementation using PR-gated phases.
repos.readme: An orchestrated, test-gated AI development pipeline for Node.js using a Ralph loop — turn a simple paragraph into a planned, tested, reviewed, fully working implementation using PR-gated phases.

repos.name: PorschePi
repos.description: RaspberryPi based custom head unit for classic Porsche, supporting wireless CarPlay and featuring an integrated Bang & Olufsen amplifier.
repos.readme: RaspberryPi based custom head unit for classic Porsche. Inspired by the Porsche Classic Communication Management (PCCM) (91164559100), featuring a much larger touchscreen and the ability to use CarPlay wirelessly.
